record.chaining: The 730-hour price of R$ 34.99 on the smallest instance means R$ 100 covers roughly two and a half months of a 1 vCPU / 1 GiB box with free egress, which composes with the free-egress term if a Brazilian tax number exists.

identity_cost.detail: a Brazilian tax number plus a credit card: billing data requires 'Nome completo ou razao social', 'CPF ou CNPJ valido', 'Endereco de faturamento' and 'Cartao de credito valido', and the CPF/CNPJ cannot be changed after registration. Adding the card raises a verification charge quoted as 'a R$5.00 to R$9.99 verification charge' ('Adicione um cartao de credito'), which is an authorisation-scale amount rather than a published hold. Whether a debit or prepaid card passes that verification is not stated.

evidence.proved: 'Os R$100 em creditos sao liberados automaticamente apos a ativacao de qualquer recurso: R$50 no 1o mes + R$50 no 2o', and the activation flow requires 'Adicione um cartao de credito' with a R$5.00 to R$9.99 verification charge, quoted

cheapest BV instance SKU BR4100000100CB0AS0010 is 1 vCPU, 1 GB RAM, 10 GB disk at R$ 34.99 per 730 h, 'valores vigentes em 02/10/2026', quoted
a separate seller promotion gives 'R$300 em creditos para experimentar a Magalu Cloud por 30 dias', restricted to sellers with sales in the last 12 months contracting on the registered CNPJ, quoted

record.notes: The R$ 300 seller credit is the larger number and it is institution-gated twice: an active Marketplace seller account and a CNPJ. The free-egress term is the real prize here, because it removes the usual per-GiB egress cost on a regional cloud; it is stated as currently free with no commitment, so it can be withdrawn at any time. A Brazilian CPF is obtainable by a resident only; that is what makes this fails-identity rather than qualifies-with-caveat.
